Hi,

I’m Mengyu Cao (MC), a product designer with a foundation in visual art and a focus on human-centered, systems-driven design. My work sits at the intersection of user needs, business strategy, and technical feasibility, with an emphasis on clarity, scalability, and long-term impact.

I began my career in visual communication, trained in traditional Chinese painting, watercolor, and sketching. This background sharpened my ability to observe patterns, distill complexity, and communicate with intention. These skills continue to inform my approach to product design.

I earned my BFA in Visual Communication in Beijing, where I developed a strong foundation in contextual thinking. I learned that effective design is not driven by aesthetics alone, but by a deep understanding of the problem space shaped by culture, history, constraints, and business goals.

At Parsons School of Design, I transitioned into digital product design to operate at greater scale. Since then, I’ve designed products across industries and organizational stages, from early concepts to mature systems. I focus on defining problems clearly, aligning stakeholders, and translating ambiguous requirements into structured, scalable solutions.

As a designer, I prioritize depth of understanding of users, edge cases, and system behaviors, while also thinking in terms of end-to-end experiences. I am particularly interested in building design systems, improving cross-platform consistency, and creating frameworks that enable teams to move faster without sacrificing quality.

I see design as both craft and leadership. Beyond execution, I contribute through shaping product direction, mentoring, and elevating design quality across teams. I value thoughtful collaboration, a strong point of view, and the ability to navigate trade-offs with clarity and integrity.

I have lived and worked across China and the United States, including Beijing, New York, Boston, and the Bay Area. These experiences continue to inform how I approach culture, communication, and design at a global scale.

Thank you for visiting. I am always open to thoughtful conversations and collaboration.

MC
